name: Daily Keyword Cloud — Async Precompute
description: Andrew direct 2026-05-28: the keyword 'daily cloud' analysis (market-performance keyword/topic cloud, GPT-analyzed) runs on-demand and is far too slow (GPT latency on the request path). Move it off the request path — precompute asynchronously on a schedule, cache to S3, and have the consumer pull the ready artifact instead of triggering GPT live. The analysis is daily-grained so per-view GPT latency is wasteful. Lean project: leverage existing GPT logic (keyword_intelligence_generator / news_trending_analysis), add async schedule (EventBridge) + cache artifact + consumer repoint with graceful fallback; do not rebuild GPT logic. Consumer = portal/src/components/market-performance/TopicCloud.tsx. Pipeline = news-pipeline (sibling to MKOV_TRENDS).
